timesheets.title: Timesheets
timesheets.description: Choose which timesheet actions are automated and how proximity controls apply to manual clock-ins.
timesheets.sumProximityOff: Team members can clock in from anywhere
timesheets.sumProximityOn: Team members can only clock in within {{radius}} m of their location

sumClock.none: Team members are not automatically clocked in or out
sumClock.in: Team members are automatically clocked in at the start of scheduled shifts
sumClock.out: Team members are automatically clocked out at the end of scheduled shifts
sumClock.both: Team members are automatically clocked in and out of scheduled shifts

timesheets.sumBreaksOff: Scheduled breaks are not started or stopped automatically
timesheets.sumBreaksOn: Scheduled breaks are started and stopped automatically
timesheets.proximityBody: Allow team members to only clock in within the configured distance of the location. Edit your
timesheets.automationsBody: Configure which timesheet entries are automatically created from your schedule.
timesheets.autoInHint: Automatically clock in at the beginning of scheduled shifts
timesheets.autoOutHint: Automatically clock out at the end of scheduled shifts
timesheets.autoBreaks: Auto start and end scheduled breaks
timesheets.autoBreaksHint: Automatically record timesheet entries when scheduled breaks start and end
timesheets.footerNote: These settings can be customized individually per team member

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.description: Choose whether shifts should be automatically created for team members or created manually.

shifts.sumOff: Shifts are created manually for new team members and new locations
shifts.autoCreate: Automatically create shifts for team members
shifts.autoCreateHint: Create shifts when adding new team members or assigning team members to new locations. Shifts will match the location's opening hours and can be edited from Scheduled shifts.

commissions.title: Commissions
commissions.description: Manage default global commission settings to be applied to new team members.
commissions.footer: You can customize commission settings per team member

deductDiscounts.label: Deduct discounts
deductDiscounts.hint: Deduct discounts applied to sale price of any product, service, membership and gift card, prior to calculating commission

deductTaxes.label: Deduct taxes
deductTaxes.hint: Deduct taxes from sale price prior to calculating commission

deductServiceCost.label: Deduct service cost
deductServiceCost.hint: Deduct service cost from sale price prior to calculating commission

deductProductCost.label: Deduct product cost
deductProductCost.hint: Deduct product cost from sale price prior to calculating commission

packageServices.label: Earn commission on services paid for with a package
packageServices.hint: Commission is earned on services paid for with a package

membershipServices.label: Earn commission on services paid for with a membership
membershipServices.hint: Commission is earned on services paid for with a membership

loyaltyFull.label: Earn full commission when loyalty points are redeemed
loyaltyFull.hint: Commission is calculated on the sale amount before loyalty points are deducted

fullyPaidOnly.label: Earn commissions on fully paid invoices
fullyPaidOnly.hint: Commission is only applied on invoices once they are marked as fully paid

exceedPaid.label: Earn commission even if it exceeds the amount paid
exceedPaid.hint: Commission can be earned even if it's higher than the amount paid for the service
